title: MacroTracker
description: MacroTracker is a mobile-first web app for tracking daily calories and protein intake. It features circular progress rings, automatic daily resets at midnight, a quick-add system that learns your frequent foods, weight tracking with trend charts, and a 14-day history view with rolling averages. Built with React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Recharts, the entire app runs client-side with localStorage — no accounts or servers required. Deployed on Vercel.

title: Beer Predictor
description: A beer-style classification system using a Random Forest model, achieving a 231% performance increase over a majority-class baseline. Designed an end-to-end ML pipeline for sparse, high-dimensional ingredient data using SciPy CSR matrices and scikit-learn, optimizing memory efficiency and training time.

title: Stock Price Predictor
description: A stock price prediction AI model that automates data ingestion, preprocessing, and forecasting using Machine Learning frameworks and the Yahoo Finance API. Enhanced model performance by up to 70% through learning rate tuning and training dataset optimization. Features data-driven visualizations with Matplotlib.
tech_stack: Python, PyTorch, NumPy, pandas, Matplotlib, yfinance, scikit-learn

title: Polygon Party
description: A cooperative 2D puzzle platformer developed from concept to release using Unity and C#. Features custom physics and collision detection tailored to game mechanics. Led a team using Git for version control, ensuring smooth collaboration and code integration.
